kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اؤتلقت (form VIII)
# اُؤْتُلِقْتُ (uʔtuliqtu) /uʔ.tu.liq.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# اُؤْتُلِقْتَ (uʔtuliqta) /uʔ.tu.liq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# اُؤْتُلِقْتِ (uʔtuliqti) /uʔ.tu.liq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# اُؤْتُلِقَتْ (uʔtuliqat) /uʔ.tu.li.qat/: third-pe
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
